name: Stalk With The Earthmother
summary: Boarton Shadetotem asks you to fillet a Raw Brilliant Smallfish in Thunder Bluff. He hopes the exercise will reveal a talent for subtle arts.

sections.title: A Final Trial
sections.body: Boarton Shadetotem in Thunder Bluff asks you to show what comes naturally with his Knife Set. Bring him a Raw Brilliant Smallfish and fillet it before him. He hopes this less direct test will uncover hidden talent.

sections.title: Parting Words
sections.body: Boarton Shadetotem sees that you lack the rogueish precision he sought. He offers a parting gift and sends you on your travels, wishing the Horde heroes like you.

faq.q: Who is asking me to fillet a fish?
faq.answer: Boarton Shadetotem in Thunder Bluff asks you to fillet a Raw Brilliant Smallfish with his Knife Set.

faq.q: Why does Boarton want me to fillet a fish?
faq.answer: Boarton hopes the exercise will bring out a hidden talent for subtle arts.

faq.q: What fish does Boarton ask for?
faq.answer: Boarton asks for a Raw Brilliant Smallfish.

faq.q: Where do I fillet the fish?
faq.answer: Fillet the Raw Brilliant Smallfish in front of Boarton Shadetotem in Thunder Bluff.
